all_recall_before_cm.rule: >= 8/10 of all seeds per scenario alert on the true scope before margin shows it

holdout_recall_before_cm.rule: >= 8/10 of holdout seeds per scenario alert on the true scope before margin shows it

summary.note: raw-SQL mode can read mart_segment_week, the semantic layer's own pre-aggregated input

all_briefs_valid.rule: every eval brief published (a failed brief never counts as grounded)

grounding_100.rule: 100% of numbers in the briefs match their cited facts

brief_accuracy.rule: >= 90% of sections accurate in every brief AND zero direction errors

top_action_true_scope.rule: each brief's top-ranked action is on an injected scope

sample_scale_labeled.rule: every action section labels its $ as sample-scale

abstention_100.rule: abstains on all 5 unanswerable questions (semantic-layer mode)
